preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The size of the array is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the array is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines.
Each line contains exactly two integers separated by a space.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= index < N for index, _ in (line.split() for line in output))
postconditions.description: The first integer in each line is the index of the rotation.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= inversions <= N * (N - 1) / 2 for _, inversions in (line.split() for line in output))
postconditions.description: The second integer in each line is the number of inversions for the corresponding rotation.

postconditions.expression: all(all(a[(i + index) % N] <= a[(j + index) % N] for j in range(i + 1, N)) for index, inversions in (line.split() for line in output))
postconditions.description: The array after the corresponding rotation has the maximum number of inversions.

postconditions.expression: all(all(a[(i + i0) % N] == a[(i + i1) % N] for i in range(N)) for i0, i1 in permutations(range(N), 2) if i0 < i1)
postconditions.description: If multiple rotations have the same number of inversions, the lexicographically smallest rotation is chosen.
